marketplace.title: Marketplace
marketplace.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for an official Amazon store. GB and UK are the same store.

category.title: Department -> Subcategory
category.description: One All-menu path. Department and subcategory are in this single dropdown, e.g. "Beauty, Health, Grocery -> Health & Personal Care". Pick "Department -> (All)" to scrape the whole department. Short names such as "Electronics -> Headphones" also resolve on marketplaces that group that department (India: "TV, Appliances, Electronics").

maxPages.title: Pages to scrape
maxPages.description: How many Amazon listing pages to fetch. 0 or empty means no page limit: keep going until Amazon returns no new products.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: With product details on, stop after this many stored product rows. 0 or empty means no item limit.

enrichDetails.title: Fetch product details
enrichDetails.description: Open each product page for brand, About this item, description, and overview. Rows are stored only when those details parse. Turn off to store listing cards only.

maxConcurrency.title: Detail-page concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many product pages to fetch at once. Each worker keeps a sticky residential IP and rotates it after about 25 pages or on a block. Default 20, max 80. Higher values burn more proxy GB on Amazon.com robot checks.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Residential proxies with sticky sessions. Amazon blocks most datacenter IPs. If you leave country empty, the actor uses the selected marketplace (US store → US IPs). Mismatched country often returns HTTP 503 on listing page 1.
